subject: Life Sciences
assessment_title: Life Sciences Grade 12 Term 4 Controlled Assessment Pack

visual_blueprint.subject: Life Sciences
assessment_content_focus: final integrated Life Sciences examination practice
genetics, evolution, reproduction, homeostasis and investigation skills
data, diagrams, variables, validity, reliability and conclusion writing
cross-topic biological reasoning with source and diagram evidence

required_visuals.title: Science data table or graph stimulus

generation_constraints: Every question must be answerable from the stated term focus, supplied stimulus and grade-appropriate subject knowledge.
Educator approval is required before classroom use.

sections.title: Section A: Concepts And Data
sections.instructions: Use the supplied data, diagram or graph.
sections.stimulus: Data/diagram stimulus linked to final integrated Life Sciences examination practice.

questions.question: Define one key concept from the term focus.
Describe the trend or relationship shown by the supplied data.
Explain the process or principle using correct terminology.
Calculate or infer a result from the supplied values and show working where needed.

sections.title: Section B: Investigation Design
sections.stimulus: Investigation focus: data, diagrams, variables, validity, reliability and conclusion writing.

questions.question: State a suitable aim or hypothesis for the investigation.
Identify independent, dependent and controlled variables.
Evaluate validity and reliability and suggest one improvement.

sections.title: Section C: Application
sections.instructions: Use subject knowledge and supplied evidence.
sections.stimulus: Application focus: cross-topic biological reasoning with source and diagram evidence.

questions.question: Answer an integrated explanation question using evidence from the stimulus.

rubric.descriptor: Answers are clear, complete and structured.

teacher_review_checklist: Confirm CAPS term and topic fit before classroom use.
Insert or approve final source material where the pack requests educator-supplied sources.
Check mark allocation, memo wording and learner level.
Confirm visuals are suitable and not treated as official source material unless sourced separately.
